note: Corrected 2026-09-05 after an audit found the demo was pointed at the wrong control entirely. RUN AI ANALYSIS is button#schBtnRunAnalysis in the Grants tab (#tab-grants, opened via [data-tab="grants"]), reachable only after #schBtnLoadSample has loaded sample data; its output renders into #schAiOutput (not #ai-output), and schRunAnalysis() internally calls schWriteRelay() to push to the relay control plane -- there is no separate manual relay button. The previous version of this script instead opened the unrelated AI Analysis tab (#tab-ai) and clicked #analyze-btn, which only runs the free-text tax/compliance Q&A tool (runAnalysis() -> callAI()) and never calls schWriteRelay() -- so Strategist and Executive Portal received no relay data and would have rendered empty (renderEmpty(), no .kpi-row) in a live demo. Confirmed live end-to-end against a running server.js instance in this audit (login, sample data load, relay write, and the financial-summary endpoint were all exercised directly), though the exact click-through sequence below has still not been run through Playwright itself -- browser download is blocked in this sandbox by the same restriction noted previously. Strategist and Executive Portal are both auto-rendering (render()/#wrap innerHTML from relay data on page load, storage + TSM_RELAY_EVENT listeners for live updates) and link to each other via plain <a class=hbtn> anchors, same as Mortgage. Run once with a real browser and correct any further selector drift before treating as final.
